clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Fire is a shamanic rite of passage overseen by the Windshapers within Skywall. Initiates must aid in invoking spirits of flame, capture the Eternal Flame, and race against time to kindle the brazier at Valanaar. Successfully completing the trial proves one's respect for the elements and earns the initiate their Fire Totem.

The Call of Fire is a sacred trial of elemental attunement conducted within Skywall. Led by Olariaan of the Windshapers, initiates gather at the Brazier of Offering to invoke the spirits of flame from the Firelands. If the offerings are deemed worthy, the spirits ignite the altar with the sacred Eternal Flame, ready to be harnessed by a worthy aspirant.

Once lit, the Eternal Flame must be captured onto a torch and carried swiftly across Skywall to Valanaar. Because the energies of the Firelands naturally weaken and disperse in the swirling atmosphere of the elemental air realm, the initiate faces a race against time to reach the Brazier of Eternal Flames before the flame dies out.

Rekindling the brazier at Valanaar proves the initiate's discipline and reverence toward the elements. In recognition of this achievement, the Windshapers bestow the initiate with their Fire Totem. As taught by the elders, elemental power readily serves those who respect it, but will mercilessly consume those who do not.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now we will perform the ritual.

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.
Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.
Your trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, friend.
Just remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.
